title: Brands
description: Several brands in one organization: each brand has its own logo, colors, email sender, help center address, widget defaults, signature, business hours and SLA policy.
forbidden: You do not have permission to view brands.
empty: No brands yet. Channels and conversations without a brand use the organization's own identity.
error.title: Could not load brands
error.description: Refresh the page and try again.
confirm_delete.title: Delete brand?
confirm_delete.description: "{{name}}" will be deleted. Brands linked to a channel, conversation or article cannot be deleted.
toast.failed: The action could not be completed. Try again.
toast.in_use: This brand is in use and cannot be deleted.
dialog.description: Changes apply to this brand's channels, widgets and new conversations once saved.
dialog.invalid: Check the fields marked in red (color #rrggbb, valid email, lowercase host and path).
fields.name: Brand name
fields.logo_hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP. Stored in your organization's storage.
fields.signature_hint: Plain text. Appended to this brand's email replies.
fields.help_subdomain_hint: Host that opens this brand's help center (e.g. help.brand.com). Point its DNS record to the app.
fields.help_path_hint: Without a host: the brand path under the organization's help center (lowercase letters, digits and dashes).
fields.sla_forbidden: You do not have permission to view SLA policies; the current choice is kept.
fields.sla_hint: This brand's conversations use the selected policy's targets and calendar.
fields.ai_persona_hint: Tone and style the AI uses when answering on behalf of this brand.
email.hint: The sender's domain must be verified for the organization; otherwise the organization's default sender is used.
help.articles_hint: To show articles in this brand's help center, pick the brand while editing an article in the knowledge base.
widget.hint: Widgets linked to this brand take color and business hours from the brand. Fields left empty fall back to the widget's own settings; a value set on the widget always wins.
widget.hours_hint: Outside these hours the widget shows as offline. The SLA calendar comes from the SLA policy.
select.label: Brand
select.channel_hint: New conversations from this channel open under this brand; emails go out with its sender and signature.
select.widget_hint: The widget color and business hours come from the brand.
article.label: Brand help center
article.hint: Assigns the article to the selected brand's help center.
